items.overview: After a bad date, Hailey, rather begrudged, partakes in a cigarette, leading to a destructive and ridiculous consequence.
items.title: Biscuit Poltergeist

items.original_title: From Baseball to Bloodshed - When Unconditional Love Turns Deadly
items.title: From Baseball to Bloodshed - When Unconditional Love Turns Deadly

items.overview: A action-drama movie about if the gunpowder plot succeeded
items.title: Plan Fawks

items.overview: Vostrov, a talented sound engineer who despises the cynicism of the entertainment industry, agrees to fabricate audio evidence of infidelity for a jealous client. He has no idea that his professional lie will trigger an act of domestic violence.
items.title: Sound Pressure

items.overview: A little boy visits his grandparents, but the grandmother is missing and the grandfather is acting weird.
items.title: Chaos Is The True Nature of Things

items.original_title: Photomaton, la grande histoire de la petite photo
items.title: Photomaton, la grande histoire de la petite photo

items.overview: After this, there's no turning back
items.title: Connor (Muppet Movie 2.0)

items.original_title: Darius Rucker: They Called Me Hootie
items.overview: Darius Rucker gets deeply personal about the cost of stardom, revealing his struggles with drugs and alcohol, the breakdown of his marriage and brushes with death. Through candid interviews with collaborators, friends and family, new footage from the road and in the studio as he records his forthcoming album and never-before-seen tape dating back to the start of Hootie & the Blowfish, this documentary traces the full journey of his extraordinary career, revealing a deeply personal story of ambition, resilience and reinvention.
items.title: Darius Rucker: They Called Me Hootie

items.overview: At 83, Louise Forestier is a freer, more engaged, and more vibrant artist than ever. Structured in nine chapters, like the nine songs on her latest album, this "docu-musical" unfolds as an ode to nature and the passage of time.
items.title: Old Crow

items.overview: A young man helps his friend overcome his insecurities about cricket by sharing his own unfulfilled childhood dream, reminding him that we don't have to be good at something to enjoy doing it. A heartwarming story about friendship, childhood passion, and never losing the inner child.
items.title: Mazhalai

items.original_title: Piccola anatomia di corpi al lavoro
items.overview: The four directors build the narrative around these repetitive movements: moving objects, operating machinery, digging holes and laying foundations. The workers' bodies follow a precisely timed routine, leading the viewer to question what an artistic gesture is. This routine is interrupted by the metamorphosis of the images, as the workers' silhouettes detach themselves from reality to become two-dimensional projections on a screen. The conventional meaning usually given to manual labor is subverted, taking on an entirely new significance.
items.title: Piccola anatomia di corpi al lavoro

items.original_title: Canti della specie - Un viaggio con Antonio Moresco
items.overview: What if the end is simply a moment of transition? In Canti della specie, we hear the voice and thoughts of the writer Antonio Moresco on human extinction through five deliberately conflicting conversations.
items.title: Canti della specie - Un viaggio con Antonio Moresco

items.overview: On 3 February 2018, Luca Traini opens fire in the streets of Macerata, wounding six people. Two of them, Kofi Wilson and Omar Fadera, had reached Italy after a dangerous journey from Ghana and Gambia, risking their lives in the desert and in Libya. They believed they were finally safe in Macerata: “Maybe I’m in Heaven,” Kofi says. But they were not.
items.title: Heaven

items.original_title: The Noah Movie; Epilogue: The Last Don
items.overview: 4 years after the events of “The Noah Movie: The Complete Epic”,  Noah Feliz is operating quietly in New York City.  Things go wrong quickly once again when he almost gets killed at a friendly dinner hosted by fellow don, Salvatore Giorgio. See how it all ends in this fantastic conclusion to an amazing crime saga.
items.title: The Noah Movie; Epilogue: The Last Don

items.overview: A poetic and political investigation into eroticism as a vital force. The documentary essay delves into the tension between control and desire to explore what remains of the erotic in a society shaped by guilt and colonial logic. Uniting philosophy, psychoanalysis, and art through deep interviews and visceral performances, the film challenges moral constraints and invites us to recognize the body as the first territory to be counter-colonized.
items.title: erōtikós

items.original_title: The Neighbourhood is Changing: Revisiting Mulberry Street
items.overview: In 2005, a group of up-and-coming filmmakers based in Lower Manhattan set out to make an independent horror film called Mulberry Street, in which a virus turns ordinary New Yorkers into rat people. 20 years later, they reflect on the making of the film and what it has to say about the evolution of New York City.
items.title: The Neighbourhood is Changing: Revisiting Mulberry Street

items.overview: A hypnotic journey through the archive of María Tupper (1893–1965), a Chilean artist and spiritualist who tirelessly compiled and organized her photographs, drawings, paintings, diaries, letters, and 8mm films.
items.title: Los Fantasmas de María

items.overview: June stays endlessly busy and tethered to her devices to keep her demons at bay. But when she forgets to plug in her phone before falling asleep, she’s forced to face the monster her denial has unleashed.
items.title: The Monster I Made

items.overview: Set on Halloween night, CUTS follows a group of young friends who cross paths with a mysterious figure wearing a cracked clown mask. What they mistake for an elaborate Halloween prank quickly descends into a brutal fight for survival.
items.title: Cuts

items.original_title: 在你心之所向的地方 电影版
items.overview: Childhood friends Ling Zi Ming and Cheng Yi, along with bickering duo Lu Xiang Lin and Yue Yu Zhi, have grown up side by side. The four boys share the happiest days of their youth together, but along the way, subtle changes begin to emerge in their feelings for one another. They once believed they would never have to say goodbye, yet as they grow older, their paths gradually lead them in different directions...
items.title: In Your Heart Movie Version

items.overview: A lonely house on a farm is haunted by a scarecrow, but what lives inside the house is far more dangerous.
items.title: Hollow Ones

items.overview: As a burdened teen girl’s hallucinations intensify, she confides in her devout mother, unaware of a buried truth resurfacing to fracture the reality within their home.
items.title: The Fraying

items.overview: Eclipse of the moon. The shadow of the earth gets projected onto the moon's surface. The Super-8 camera tries to catch it. A playful imprint on the emulsion, brought back to light by hand in the darkroom.
items.title: Schattenfangen

items.overview: Immersive and poetic film in which a dancer from Honduras leaves the city to return to the Afro-Caribbean Garifuna community of his youth, searching for his past, cultural identity, healing rituals, and a sense of connection.
items.title: Where the Sun is Born

items.overview: This deep dive into Romania's chaotic 2025 elections echoes global patterns of democratic erosion and the growth of fascist movements—with social media fueling the frenzy.
items.title: Small Expectations

items.overview: Cyprus, July 1974. President Makarios has been ousted in a coup, and a Turkish invasion is imminent. A pilot recounts the very last flight to Nicosia Airport: should he land or not?
items.title: No Man's Air

items.overview: An essay film exploring the gap between the propaganda and reality of Soviet labor camps. Composed entirely of archival footage that often evokes a reality all its own, it juxtaposes conflicting accounts from figures including Gorky and Solzhenitsyn.
items.title: My Own Personal Gulag

items.overview: After his childhood friend Vaguinho commits suicide, Rodolpho decides to devote a novel to his rebellious friend. Vaguinho was a leading figure in the punk movement of the farming community where they grew up, amid plantations drenched in pesticides.
items.title: Morro Grande

items.overview: On 14 March 1978, 17-year-old Rico Carpaye was killed by far-right militants on the island of Réunion. Those responsible went unpunished. Nearly 50 years later, this desktop documentary unravels the story behind the silence surrounding the crime.
items.title: A Minute of Silence

items.overview: Serene Husni, a Palestinian filmmaker living in the diaspora, returns to her parents' hometown in the occupied West Bank. Conversations with residents reveal the continuing impact of the Nakba, the mass displacement of Palestinians in 1948.
items.title: Jenin & the Nakba Between Us

items.overview: Laboring in a Cuban ship graveyard, an almost apocalyptic world of fire and creaking sheets of steel, Pitufo dreams of a better life. An atmospheric, magical glimpse into a life on society's margins.
items.title: Bahía Honda

items.overview: For years, exiled Syrian artist Assem Al-Bacha has been working on a giant sculpture of the 11th-century poet Al-Maari, intended to raise awareness of his country. Will the sculpture ever make it home?
items.title: Alter Ego

items.overview: Across football stadiums, concert halls, and religious gatherings, three Egyptians live in the shadow of famous figures they strikingly resemble. A journey into how a genetic coincidence evolved into a profession, an identity, and a destiny - and how the lookalike came to fill a space the real celebrity never could, meeting admirers in streets, villages, and local celebrations, becoming a star within reach and, at times, rivaling the original.
items.title: The Lookalike

items.overview: The film follows the months after December 1, 2024, when Edoardo Bove suddenly collapses on the pitch during Fiorentina’s match against Inter. The incident disrupts what seemed to be a clear path for one of Italian football’s brightest young talents and marks the beginning of an entirely new chapter in his life. From that moment on, Edoardo faces a suddenly uncertain future: will he play again? Will he still be able to do so in Italy? And who is Edoardo beyond football?
items.title: In un battito

items.overview: Yang, a nurse with an unusually selective sense of smell, can tolerate only disinfectant and lemon—until she encounters the scent of Fang, a man in a vegetative state. As she imagines her way into his memories, guilt and forbidden desires, the boundaries between intimacy, projection and death begin to dissolve. Moving between waking life and dream, Aroma is a dark contemporary fairy tale about the body, desire, and love that refuses to disappear when the body does.
items.title: Aroma

items.overview: A no-nonsense PR executive Lori agrees to help a charmingly irresponsible toy empire heir Emmett find love and prove he’s the right man to take over the company when his father retires – all by Christmas. But after a string of hilariously failed dates, she discovers the perfect match might be the one she never planned on: herself.
items.title: A Match for Mr. Christmas

items.overview: Documentary on the making and legacy of Mulberry Street featuring new interviews with cast and crew
items.title: The Neighbourhood is Changing

items.overview: At the end of the 70s, Eduardo Kabral continues with his TV show presenting all the members of his crew.
items.title: ¿Quién hace la...? - 1979

items.overview: On the night of her 21st birthday, a sexually frustrated virgin tries to convince her celibate boyfriend to have sex with her.
items.title: Trifecta

items.overview: Stripped of color and clothes, ready to be cleansed. A young man's midnight bath becomes a surreal nightmare the moment he realizes he is not alone.
items.title: Midnight Knocks at the Door

items.overview: An ageing Elvis impersonator finally faces up to his demons as he travels through the Irish midlands with his long-lost brother, who has recently quit his life in a monastery.
items.title: One Sweet Hour

items.overview: A young sex worker, Maria, sets out to reconnect with her estranged biological father, but their growing relationship takes an unexpected turn as she conceals her true identity, forcing her to confront the delicate line between deception and healing.
items.title: Oblivion

items.overview: "Girl and Wolf" is an animated feature film for a young adult public based on the Roc Espinet's homonymous graphic novel. It tells the story of Paula, an innocent girl who lives in a medieval village attacked by wolves. Paula will have to face dark childhood traumas, soulless hunters, magical wild spirits and an ancient pack of wolves.
items.title: Girl and Wolf

items.overview: Iliya the Knight of Murom, son of a peasant, was born disabled and was unable to walk until he turned 33. He then was miraculously healed and became a great warrior during his faithful service to Kniaz Vladimir Monomakh by fighting against invaders and helping Kniaz consolide Russianlands.
items.title: Iliya Muromets

items.overview: Sanya, a guy from the provinces, inflicts severe injuries on a local thug named Shurup while defending himself. Shurup loses consciousness, and it becomes clear that his life is in danger. Sanya hopes for the best, but the next morning, there’s a knock at the door.
items.title: Look for It

items.overview: 17th century. Twelve years after setting sail on a sea voyage, Adriano — presumed dead — returns to Marta’s coastal home in an attempt to reclaim his past with her. Upon his return, he finds the house inhabited by her new husband, Costa — a kind man who welcomes him with open arms — and the couple’s mute son. In order to avoid destroying the family, Adriano conceals his identity, pretending to be a messenger.
items.title: Volta ao Mundo

items.overview: A solitary paraglider follows the spine of the Rocky Mountains, from the Mexican border all the way to the heart of Canada, moving forward only with the wind beneath his wing or the slow rhythm of his steps, over more than 3,000km. From the southern deserts where snakes glide through the dust to the vast Canadian forests watched over by bears, his journey gradually transforms into an inner quest for the true meaning of adventure. As the landscapes unfold and solitude deepens, he discovers that the greatness of a journey does not necessarily lie in the extreme, but in those simple moments when one feels alive, far from the world, suspended between earth and sky.
items.title: Behind the Rockies

items.overview: As recent heir of the Vandycorn company, Cash J. Butters explores cheaper ways to run the family business.
items.title: Vandycorn

items.original_title: KI - Die letzte Erfindung der Menschheit?
items.title: KI - Die letzte Erfindung der Menschheit?

items.overview: Telling the story of the end of a love affair gives rise to something unexpected. Para Mì, by Caterina Bertini, began as a diary to come to terms with the end of a relationship, but gradually evolved into a photographic account of one of the most difficult periods in Cuba’s recent history.
items.title: Para Mì

items.overview: A mother and her son, deserted roads, the flight of birds. Beaches, hands, faces, flowers. Nature, cities and mechanical presences come together in Melma, by Maya Ivona Peiu and Alessia Cascone, to create a visual poem that slips into nightmare. A boy searches for his lost beloved in a post-apocalyptic world engulfed by sludge. He and she, nameless figures bound by a love that has run its course, of which only fragments and unrealized possibilities remain.
items.title: Melma

items.overview: What if AI were used not as a visual gimmick but as a human, therapeutic resource? In Lo scrittore di silenzi, a man in his seventies with ALS can communicate with the outside world only through an eye-tracking device, transferring his thoughts, memories and emotions onto a screen, accompanied by the sound his steady breathing in the background.
items.title: Lo scrittore di silenzi

items.original_title: A Space Love Story Against Oblivion
items.overview: In 1977, the Voyager probes left Earth carrying the Golden Record: a collection of images, sounds, music and greetings in fifty-five languages, an attempt to describe humankind to an unknown recipient, whose existence was uncertain, as was its ability to understand us.
items.title: A Space Love Story Against Oblivion

items.overview: Elisabetta Falanga sets out to reconstruct the childhood of her partner, Abido, in Morocco in order to understand his sudden return to religion. But their conversations end up exposing the prejudices and differences that run through their life as a couple.
items.title: Storia di un bimbo mucca

items.overview: Kevin, Kyle, and Seth are long-haired, buzzword-fluent middle managers with a passion for staying looped in and on the same page. When the ruthless Torrence Group acquires their company and sics Gen-Z efficiency experts on them, the trio must survive team-building gone haywire, a scheme to replace them with AI, and a corporate conspiracy to eliminate middle management entirely - armed with nothing but jargon, synergy, and one sacred truth: the weekend’s never long enough.
items.title: Long Haired Businessmen

items.overview: After her cub is killed by a group of backwoods hunters, an angry mama gets revenge, developing a thirst for revenge and human blood. A group of college co-eds head out on a spring break camping trip for a weekend of partying in the woods. They soon become the target of the enraged bear and must battle for survival against a blood thirsty predator.
items.title: Bad Ass Bear

items.original_title: Qué lejos están las fuentes y los pájaros
items.overview: A child touches an insect and, without realizing it, sets a journey in motion: birds and fountains guide the transformation of a world that takes shape and then falls apart. Amid the remnants of a fading splendor, the forces of the earth persist, and everything returns, like an echo, between what once was and what will never be again.
items.title: Qué lejos están las fuentes y los pájaros

items.original_title: Pensaba que te habías olvidado de escribirme
items.overview: A man recalls his time as a political prisoner during the Chilean military dictatorship at Pisagua prison: on one side, the desert; on the other, the sea. A collection of letters he sent to his wife and family meets the desert in the present. Underground images pass one after another, blurring the distinctions between stone, rock, and bone.
items.title: Pensaba que te habías olvidado de escribirme

items.overview: An urban bus beyond the limits of Xixón leads the film to a foggy periphery where everyday life begins to acquire a strange quality of mystery and loneliness. The journey is interrupted with a jazz concert in one of those cafeterias that occupy a recognizable place in the universe of Seles, while the assembly adopts the logic of a happy visual and sound improvisation.
items.title: bonus track desesperada

items.overview: Cafes, bars, stores for transfer, lottery administrations, rainy streets and other people's conversations are drawing an urban and popular Asturias, far away from any tourist postcard. Images captured almost on the fly, overprinted texts, radio fragments, interviews and sound materials follow one another with the characteristic freedom of his cinema.
items.title: asturias es jazz

items.overview: When a partner decides to go through the other person's phone and finds everything that they thought they would. They both must confront the truth of what their relationship and love are.
items.title: Love?

items.overview: Human.ID is an immersive XR documentary that plunges viewers into a near-future digital ecosystem where adaptive AI systems analyze, question, and redefine the boundaries of human identity and consciousness.
items.title: Human.ID

items.overview: In the aftermath of a devastating civil war and amid the ruins of a fractured America, a father risks everything to protect his daughter from an oppressive new regime - setting the stage for a battle that will decide the fate of humanity.
items.title: Freeborn

items.overview: Lucas, a laid-off Canadian steelworker, heads into the woods for a solo camping trip but winds up aboard a UFO. Face-to-face with a snarky alien threatening to obliterate Canada, Lucas gets one chance to convince his captor that his homeland is worth saving.
items.title: Sapped

items.overview: Cadence, an elite runner, discovers how far she will go to succeed. Subjected to a corrupt experiment that harvests adrenaline from her nightmares to enhance her performance, she faces an impossible choice when her dream is threatened: her sport or her morality.
items.title: Cadence

items.overview: After breaking up with her boyfriend, 17-year-old Wilma is gone. Neighbors hear desperate screams. Two weeks later, the police make a gruesome discovery inside a suitcase.
items.title: GW:s mord - Mordet på Wilma

items.overview: Dating expert Chelsey (Ayesha Curry) is determined to break her so-called “curse” of always getting dumped during the holiday season. But when fate reunites her with her high school flame (Matthew Daddario), she wonders if her bad luck might just be the universe’s way of leading her back to her first love.
items.title: Second Chance Holiday

items.overview: Paula is having an important day at work, but a mishap with her coffee order sets off a chain of surreal and absurd events. As she struggles to navigate the chaos, she fights to prove her worth and make her voice heard.
items.title: Intolerant

items.overview: In a locked-down megacity where reality is optional, a lonely programmer risks his mind to rescue his girlfriend from a virtual prison — only to face a truth that challenges the very meaning of salvation and free will.
items.title: KILL/SAVE

items.overview: Three HR colleagues have to deal with an unexpected, last-minute request on a late Friday afternoon.
items.title: People Experience

items.original_title: Flecha para Um Coração de Pedra
items.overview: On the outskirts of São Paulo city, a train cuts through an indigenous territory. Within this territory, Jera dreams, and in her dreams the city invades her village. In the same community, Rete, an animal that can move through different dimensions, remembers the history of an ancient river, swallowed by the city centuries ago.
items.title: Arrow For a Stone Heart

items.overview: The extraordinary ideas of an East Chinese botanist who sought to connect with the Earth's memories through the roots of a "living fossil" tree species are brought to life through creative filmmaking techniques, editing, and soundtrack.
items.title: Vertigo Garden

items.overview: Along the coast of Odisha, India, the sea is slowly swallowing entire villages. Once-fertile land is turning into barren plains, and an older generation is being left behind, with the memories of the past.
items.title: Rivers of Memory

items.overview: Are there actually extraterrestrial explanations for unidentified aerial phenomena, but we're not getting the message? With nuance, persistent curiosity, and inventive camerawork, filmmaker Guylaine Maroist sets out in search of an answer.
items.title: The Message

items.overview: A filmmaker with Cape Verdean roots films his mother in the home where, after more than 40 years of marriage, she will now live alone. As she sorts through her belongings, painful memories sometimes surface, but also liberating new insights.
items.title: The Blood of the Covenant

items.overview: In this portrait, a creative rise gradually collides with a personal fall, followed by a search for the strength to carry on. It follows his journey from the making of the album S.A.M.O. to the preparation of his biggest concert to date. Through different periods and situations, the film brings us closer to Saul's personality, his way of thinking, his relationship with music, and the people around him. In this way, the film captures not only the creation of music, but also the person at a time of profound personal and creative transformation.
items.title: Tiché Vody

items.overview: Elaheh, a literature student, lost her father three years ago during the protests against Ali Khamenei's regime. Now she is piecing her life back together, working illegally as a masseuse in a private flat. Whispers of Elaheh's magical hands spread through Tehran. Men with ties to the government book appointments, some enticed by the prospect of a "happy ending". Elaheh never wears a hijab and speaks openly about her hair, but takes only the risks she can measure. She dreams of escaping suffocating Tehran and stealing a kiss from her boyfriend, Soheil, in the heart of Berlin.
items.title: Happy Ending

items.overview: The sequel to 'The Adventures of Eskel McLaughlin'. Join Eskel McLaughlin on a new case, in a high-stakes political thriller where the future of Wales is a stake.
items.title: The Death of Eskel McLaughlin

items.overview: In 1950s Lima, a Catholic girls' boarding school clings to a cliff above the Pacific Ocean. Ana, 16, pursues holiness obsessively, secretly mortifying her body. When Rebecca, a rebellious foreigner, arrives at the school, Ana’s leadership starts to crack. As fascination turns into jealousy and desire clashes with faith, discipline takes on a dangerous charge.
items.title: On Top of the Cliff

items.original_title: Hell's No Place for a Pretty Face
items.overview: Two pornstars cross the country robbing porn theaters
items.title: Hell's No Place for a Pretty Face

items.overview: Straight from the set of HOOK, this hour-long documentary features never before seen behind the scenes footage.  Relive the adventure of creating this beloved film that has become a cult classic with extraordinary access to access to Steven Spielberg, Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman, Julia Roberts, and the crew through interviews and footage captured during production, as well as Steven Spielberg’s home movies.  Experience the triumph and trials of making HOOK in a thrilling and nostalgic time capsule that audiences will treasure.
items.title: Hook: Never, Never Ending

items.overview: In the year 1721, Sebastià Calaf, a mercenary grayed by war, tracketh a ravenous beast alongside his nephew Jaume, knowing not what foul horror awaiteth their steps.
items.title: Montpellier

items.overview: From Malevich’s “Black Square” to “Black Dog of St. Petersburg” — this is how DDT and filmmaker Sergei Kuznetsov defines the boundaries of the short 20th century. All the characters in the film are the heroes of DDT’s songs. Each episode is one track and one unique artistic method. The live‑action episodes alternate with chronicles, fragments of documentary films — both classic and little‑known — as well as with animation.
items.title: DDT XX Century

results.overview: As a burdened teen girl’s hallucinations intensify, she confides in her devout mother, unaware of a buried truth resurfacing to fracture the reality within their home.
results.title: The Fraying

results.overview: Eclipse of the moon. The shadow of the earth gets projected onto the moon's surface. The Super-8 camera tries to catch it. A playful imprint on the emulsion, brought back to light by hand in the darkroom.
results.title: Schattenfangen

results.overview: Immersive and poetic film in which a dancer from Honduras leaves the city to return to the Afro-Caribbean Garifuna community of his youth, searching for his past, cultural identity, healing rituals, and a sense of connection.
results.title: Where the Sun is Born

results.overview: This deep dive into Romania's chaotic 2025 elections echoes global patterns of democratic erosion and the growth of fascist movements—with social media fueling the frenzy.
results.title: Small Expectations

results.overview: Cyprus, July 1974. President Makarios has been ousted in a coup, and a Turkish invasion is imminent. A pilot recounts the very last flight to Nicosia Airport: should he land or not?
results.title: No Man's Air

results.overview: An essay film exploring the gap between the propaganda and reality of Soviet labor camps. Composed entirely of archival footage that often evokes a reality all its own, it juxtaposes conflicting accounts from figures including Gorky and Solzhenitsyn.
results.title: My Own Personal Gulag

results.overview: After his childhood friend Vaguinho commits suicide, Rodolpho decides to devote a novel to his rebellious friend. Vaguinho was a leading figure in the punk movement of the farming community where they grew up, amid plantations drenched in pesticides.
results.title: Morro Grande

results.overview: On 14 March 1978, 17-year-old Rico Carpaye was killed by far-right militants on the island of Réunion. Those responsible went unpunished. Nearly 50 years later, this desktop documentary unravels the story behind the silence surrounding the crime.
results.title: A Minute of Silence

results.overview: Serene Husni, a Palestinian filmmaker living in the diaspora, returns to her parents' hometown in the occupied West Bank. Conversations with residents reveal the continuing impact of the Nakba, the mass displacement of Palestinians in 1948.
results.title: Jenin & the Nakba Between Us

results.overview: Laboring in a Cuban ship graveyard, an almost apocalyptic world of fire and creaking sheets of steel, Pitufo dreams of a better life. An atmospheric, magical glimpse into a life on society's margins.
results.title: Bahía Honda

results.overview: For years, exiled Syrian artist Assem Al-Bacha has been working on a giant sculpture of the 11th-century poet Al-Maari, intended to raise awareness of his country. Will the sculpture ever make it home?
results.title: Alter Ego

results.overview: Across football stadiums, concert halls, and religious gatherings, three Egyptians live in the shadow of famous figures they strikingly resemble. A journey into how a genetic coincidence evolved into a profession, an identity, and a destiny - and how the lookalike came to fill a space the real celebrity never could, meeting admirers in streets, villages, and local celebrations, becoming a star within reach and, at times, rivaling the original.
results.title: The Lookalike

results.overview: The film follows the months after December 1, 2024, when Edoardo Bove suddenly collapses on the pitch during Fiorentina’s match against Inter. The incident disrupts what seemed to be a clear path for one of Italian football’s brightest young talents and marks the beginning of an entirely new chapter in his life. From that moment on, Edoardo faces a suddenly uncertain future: will he play again? Will he still be able to do so in Italy? And who is Edoardo beyond football?
results.title: In un battito

results.overview: Yang, a nurse with an unusually selective sense of smell, can tolerate only disinfectant and lemon—until she encounters the scent of Fang, a man in a vegetative state. As she imagines her way into his memories, guilt and forbidden desires, the boundaries between intimacy, projection and death begin to dissolve. Moving between waking life and dream, Aroma is a dark contemporary fairy tale about the body, desire, and love that refuses to disappear when the body does.
results.title: Aroma

results.overview: A no-nonsense PR executive Lori agrees to help a charmingly irresponsible toy empire heir Emmett find love and prove he’s the right man to take over the company when his father retires – all by Christmas. But after a string of hilariously failed dates, she discovers the perfect match might be the one she never planned on: herself.
results.title: A Match for Mr. Christmas

results.overview: Documentary on the making and legacy of Mulberry Street featuring new interviews with cast and crew
results.title: The Neighbourhood is Changing

results.overview: At the end of the 70s, Eduardo Kabral continues with his TV show presenting all the members of his crew.
results.title: ¿Quién hace la...? - 1979

results.overview: On the night of her 21st birthday, a sexually frustrated virgin tries to convince her celibate boyfriend to have sex with her.
results.title: Trifecta

results.overview: Stripped of color and clothes, ready to be cleansed. A young man's midnight bath becomes a surreal nightmare the moment he realizes he is not alone.
results.title: Midnight Knocks at the Door

results.overview: An ageing Elvis impersonator finally faces up to his demons as he travels through the Irish midlands with his long-lost brother, who has recently quit his life in a monastery.
results.title: One Sweet Hour

results.overview: A young sex worker, Maria, sets out to reconnect with her estranged biological father, but their growing relationship takes an unexpected turn as she conceals her true identity, forcing her to confront the delicate line between deception and healing.
results.title: Oblivion

results.overview: "Girl and Wolf" is an animated feature film for a young adult public based on the Roc Espinet's homonymous graphic novel. It tells the story of Paula, an innocent girl who lives in a medieval village attacked by wolves. Paula will have to face dark childhood traumas, soulless hunters, magical wild spirits and an ancient pack of wolves.
results.title: Girl and Wolf

results.overview: Iliya the Knight of Murom, son of a peasant, was born disabled and was unable to walk until he turned 33. He then was miraculously healed and became a great warrior during his faithful service to Kniaz Vladimir Monomakh by fighting against invaders and helping Kniaz consolide Russianlands.
results.title: Iliya Muromets

results.overview: Sanya, a guy from the provinces, inflicts severe injuries on a local thug named Shurup while defending himself. Shurup loses consciousness, and it becomes clear that his life is in danger. Sanya hopes for the best, but the next morning, there’s a knock at the door.
results.title: Look for It

results.overview: 17th century. Twelve years after setting sail on a sea voyage, Adriano — presumed dead — returns to Marta’s coastal home in an attempt to reclaim his past with her. Upon his return, he finds the house inhabited by her new husband, Costa — a kind man who welcomes him with open arms — and the couple’s mute son. In order to avoid destroying the family, Adriano conceals his identity, pretending to be a messenger.
results.title: Volta ao Mundo

results.overview: A solitary paraglider follows the spine of the Rocky Mountains, from the Mexican border all the way to the heart of Canada, moving forward only with the wind beneath his wing or the slow rhythm of his steps, over more than 3,000km. From the southern deserts where snakes glide through the dust to the vast Canadian forests watched over by bears, his journey gradually transforms into an inner quest for the true meaning of adventure. As the landscapes unfold and solitude deepens, he discovers that the greatness of a journey does not necessarily lie in the extreme, but in those simple moments when one feels alive, far from the world, suspended between earth and sky.
results.title: Behind the Rockies

results.overview: As recent heir of the Vandycorn company, Cash J. Butters explores cheaper ways to run the family business.
results.title: Vandycorn

results.original_title: KI - Die letzte Erfindung der Menschheit?
results.title: KI - Die letzte Erfindung der Menschheit?

results.overview: Telling the story of the end of a love affair gives rise to something unexpected. Para Mì, by Caterina Bertini, began as a diary to come to terms with the end of a relationship, but gradually evolved into a photographic account of one of the most difficult periods in Cuba’s recent history.
results.title: Para Mì

results.overview: A mother and her son, deserted roads, the flight of birds. Beaches, hands, faces, flowers. Nature, cities and mechanical presences come together in Melma, by Maya Ivona Peiu and Alessia Cascone, to create a visual poem that slips into nightmare. A boy searches for his lost beloved in a post-apocalyptic world engulfed by sludge. He and she, nameless figures bound by a love that has run its course, of which only fragments and unrealized possibilities remain.
results.title: Melma

results.overview: What if AI were used not as a visual gimmick but as a human, therapeutic resource? In Lo scrittore di silenzi, a man in his seventies with ALS can communicate with the outside world only through an eye-tracking device, transferring his thoughts, memories and emotions onto a screen, accompanied by the sound his steady breathing in the background.
results.title: Lo scrittore di silenzi

results.original_title: A Space Love Story Against Oblivion
results.overview: In 1977, the Voyager probes left Earth carrying the Golden Record: a collection of images, sounds, music and greetings in fifty-five languages, an attempt to describe humankind to an unknown recipient, whose existence was uncertain, as was its ability to understand us.
results.title: A Space Love Story Against Oblivion

results.overview: Elisabetta Falanga sets out to reconstruct the childhood of her partner, Abido, in Morocco in order to understand his sudden return to religion. But their conversations end up exposing the prejudices and differences that run through their life as a couple.
results.title: Storia di un bimbo mucca

results.overview: Kevin, Kyle, and Seth are long-haired, buzzword-fluent middle managers with a passion for staying looped in and on the same page. When the ruthless Torrence Group acquires their company and sics Gen-Z efficiency experts on them, the trio must survive team-building gone haywire, a scheme to replace them with AI, and a corporate conspiracy to eliminate middle management entirely - armed with nothing but jargon, synergy, and one sacred truth: the weekend’s never long enough.
results.title: Long Haired Businessmen

results.overview: After her cub is killed by a group of backwoods hunters, an angry mama gets revenge, developing a thirst for revenge and human blood. A group of college co-eds head out on a spring break camping trip for a weekend of partying in the woods. They soon become the target of the enraged bear and must battle for survival against a blood thirsty predator.
results.title: Bad Ass Bear

results.original_title: Qué lejos están las fuentes y los pájaros
results.overview: A child touches an insect and, without realizing it, sets a journey in motion: birds and fountains guide the transformation of a world that takes shape and then falls apart. Amid the remnants of a fading splendor, the forces of the earth persist, and everything returns, like an echo, between what once was and what will never be again.
results.title: Qué lejos están las fuentes y los pájaros

results.original_title: Pensaba que te habías olvidado de escribirme
results.overview: A man recalls his time as a political prisoner during the Chilean military dictatorship at Pisagua prison: on one side, the desert; on the other, the sea. A collection of letters he sent to his wife and family meets the desert in the present. Underground images pass one after another, blurring the distinctions between stone, rock, and bone.
results.title: Pensaba que te habías olvidado de escribirme

results.overview: An urban bus beyond the limits of Xixón leads the film to a foggy periphery where everyday life begins to acquire a strange quality of mystery and loneliness. The journey is interrupted with a jazz concert in one of those cafeterias that occupy a recognizable place in the universe of Seles, while the assembly adopts the logic of a happy visual and sound improvisation.
results.title: bonus track desesperada

results.overview: Cafes, bars, stores for transfer, lottery administrations, rainy streets and other people's conversations are drawing an urban and popular Asturias, far away from any tourist postcard. Images captured almost on the fly, overprinted texts, radio fragments, interviews and sound materials follow one another with the characteristic freedom of his cinema.
results.title: asturias es jazz

results.overview: When a partner decides to go through the other person's phone and finds everything that they thought they would. They both must confront the truth of what their relationship and love are.
results.title: Love?

results.overview: Human.ID is an immersive XR documentary that plunges viewers into a near-future digital ecosystem where adaptive AI systems analyze, question, and redefine the boundaries of human identity and consciousness.
results.title: Human.ID

results.overview: In the aftermath of a devastating civil war and amid the ruins of a fractured America, a father risks everything to protect his daughter from an oppressive new regime - setting the stage for a battle that will decide the fate of humanity.
results.title: Freeborn

results.overview: Lucas, a laid-off Canadian steelworker, heads into the woods for a solo camping trip but winds up aboard a UFO. Face-to-face with a snarky alien threatening to obliterate Canada, Lucas gets one chance to convince his captor that his homeland is worth saving.
results.title: Sapped

results.overview: Cadence, an elite runner, discovers how far she will go to succeed. Subjected to a corrupt experiment that harvests adrenaline from her nightmares to enhance her performance, she faces an impossible choice when her dream is threatened: her sport or her morality.
results.title: Cadence

results.overview: After breaking up with her boyfriend, 17-year-old Wilma is gone. Neighbors hear desperate screams. Two weeks later, the police make a gruesome discovery inside a suitcase.
results.title: GW:s mord - Mordet på Wilma

results.overview: Dating expert Chelsey (Ayesha Curry) is determined to break her so-called “curse” of always getting dumped during the holiday season. But when fate reunites her with her high school flame (Matthew Daddario), she wonders if her bad luck might just be the universe’s way of leading her back to her first love.
results.title: Second Chance Holiday

results.overview: Paula is having an important day at work, but a mishap with her coffee order sets off a chain of surreal and absurd events. As she struggles to navigate the chaos, she fights to prove her worth and make her voice heard.
results.title: Intolerant

results.overview: In a locked-down megacity where reality is optional, a lonely programmer risks his mind to rescue his girlfriend from a virtual prison — only to face a truth that challenges the very meaning of salvation and free will.
results.title: KILL/SAVE

results.overview: Three HR colleagues have to deal with an unexpected, last-minute request on a late Friday afternoon.
results.title: People Experience

results.original_title: Flecha para Um Coração de Pedra
results.overview: On the outskirts of São Paulo city, a train cuts through an indigenous territory. Within this territory, Jera dreams, and in her dreams the city invades her village. In the same community, Rete, an animal that can move through different dimensions, remembers the history of an ancient river, swallowed by the city centuries ago.
results.title: Arrow For a Stone Heart

results.overview: The extraordinary ideas of an East Chinese botanist who sought to connect with the Earth's memories through the roots of a "living fossil" tree species are brought to life through creative filmmaking techniques, editing, and soundtrack.
results.title: Vertigo Garden

results.overview: Along the coast of Odisha, India, the sea is slowly swallowing entire villages. Once-fertile land is turning into barren plains, and an older generation is being left behind, with the memories of the past.
results.title: Rivers of Memory

results.overview: Are there actually extraterrestrial explanations for unidentified aerial phenomena, but we're not getting the message? With nuance, persistent curiosity, and inventive camerawork, filmmaker Guylaine Maroist sets out in search of an answer.
results.title: The Message

results.overview: A filmmaker with Cape Verdean roots films his mother in the home where, after more than 40 years of marriage, she will now live alone. As she sorts through her belongings, painful memories sometimes surface, but also liberating new insights.
results.title: The Blood of the Covenant

results.overview: In this portrait, a creative rise gradually collides with a personal fall, followed by a search for the strength to carry on. It follows his journey from the making of the album S.A.M.O. to the preparation of his biggest concert to date. Through different periods and situations, the film brings us closer to Saul's personality, his way of thinking, his relationship with music, and the people around him. In this way, the film captures not only the creation of music, but also the person at a time of profound personal and creative transformation.
results.title: Tiché Vody

results.overview: Elaheh, a literature student, lost her father three years ago during the protests against Ali Khamenei's regime. Now she is piecing her life back together, working illegally as a masseuse in a private flat. Whispers of Elaheh's magical hands spread through Tehran. Men with ties to the government book appointments, some enticed by the prospect of a "happy ending". Elaheh never wears a hijab and speaks openly about her hair, but takes only the risks she can measure. She dreams of escaping suffocating Tehran and stealing a kiss from her boyfriend, Soheil, in the heart of Berlin.
results.title: Happy Ending

results.overview: The sequel to 'The Adventures of Eskel McLaughlin'. Join Eskel McLaughlin on a new case, in a high-stakes political thriller where the future of Wales is a stake.
results.title: The Death of Eskel McLaughlin

results.overview: In 1950s Lima, a Catholic girls' boarding school clings to a cliff above the Pacific Ocean. Ana, 16, pursues holiness obsessively, secretly mortifying her body. When Rebecca, a rebellious foreigner, arrives at the school, Ana’s leadership starts to crack. As fascination turns into jealousy and desire clashes with faith, discipline takes on a dangerous charge.
results.title: On Top of the Cliff

results.original_title: Hell's No Place for a Pretty Face
results.overview: Two pornstars cross the country robbing porn theaters
results.title: Hell's No Place for a Pretty Face

results.overview: Straight from the set of HOOK, this hour-long documentary features never before seen behind the scenes footage.  Relive the adventure of creating this beloved film that has become a cult classic with extraordinary access to access to Steven Spielberg, Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman, Julia Roberts, and the crew through interviews and footage captured during production, as well as Steven Spielberg’s home movies.  Experience the triumph and trials of making HOOK in a thrilling and nostalgic time capsule that audiences will treasure.
results.title: Hook: Never, Never Ending

results.overview: In the year 1721, Sebastià Calaf, a mercenary grayed by war, tracketh a ravenous beast alongside his nephew Jaume, knowing not what foul horror awaiteth their steps.
results.title: Montpellier

results.overview: From Malevich’s “Black Square” to “Black Dog of St. Petersburg” — this is how DDT and filmmaker Sergei Kuznetsov defines the boundaries of the short 20th century. All the characters in the film are the heroes of DDT’s songs. Each episode is one track and one unique artistic method. The live‑action episodes alternate with chronicles, fragments of documentary films — both classic and little‑known — as well as with animation.
results.title: DDT XX Century
